intro: Micah was a country prophet who spoke up for the poor against the powerful, in the time of Isaiah.
Chapters one to three warn Samaria and Jerusalem. Chapters four and five promise peace, and a ruler to come from little Bethlehem.
Chapters six and seven bring it home: what God really asks of us.
Listen for one of the Bible's best-loved lines: do justly, and love mercy, and walk humbly with thy God.
